# U19: See the same goals as a table, board or history grid, and export them, and a filtered All tab as shown

- **Belongs to:** the Spreadsheets module ([its section](../README.md#journeys-and-checks)); it runs with the module on
- **Requirements:** `VIEWS`, `EXPORT`, `STORY`
- **Budget:** at most 19 steps on each width
- **Ease test:** every point but `errors` ([the ease test](../../../core/journeys.md#the-ease-test))
- **Runs on:** a phone (390 × 844) and a desktop (1440 × 900), the same lines on each unless one says otherwise
- **Starts:** As Rhea, at `/goals?scope=all` in the demo.
- **Source:** `evals/journeys.cjs`, the entry for U19

## Steps and checks

- Open a fresh browser as Rhea (`rhea`).
- Go to `/goals?scope=all` in the demo.
- **Check:** (`entry`) the Layout menu, or the phone’s View button (`.layout-menu > summary, .goals-phone-switch .view-open`) is in view without scrolling (above the phone’s tab bar).
- _Note:_ Table: sorting by status puts the off-track goal first.
- **Step.** Choose the “Table” layout (the Layout menu on a computer; the View sheet on a phone).
- **Check:** The gtable (`.gtable`) shows.
- **Check:** Checkpoint “table”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- **Step.** Press the “Status” button in the gtable (`.gtable`).
- **Check:** (`attention`) met when `first === 'off'`, where `const first = await p.locator('.gtable').first().locator('tbody tr').first().getAttribute('data-tone')`. Else it says: sorting by status put “{first}” first.
- _Note:_ Board: a column per status.
- **Step.** Choose the “Board” layout (the Layout menu on a computer; the View sheet on a phone).
- **Check:** The board (`.board`) shows.
- For each of `['Off track', 'At risk', 'No recent update', 'On track']`:
  - **Check:** {col} is shown.
- _Note:_ Each card names the goal it feeds into (backlog GP); the page's count line counts the same goals the lanes do.
- **Check:** (`parity`) the board parent in the board card (`.board-card .board-parent`) is there and on a phone or the Goals count line is visible (else: board cards don’t name their parent, or there’s no health line).
- **Check:** Checkpoint “board”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- _Note:_ History: a square per goal per week, the owner's call.
- **Step.** Choose the “History” layout (the Layout menu on a computer; the View sheet on a phone).
- _Note:_ History opens on quarter results; the owners' weekly calls are one press away.
- **Check:** The qtable (`.qtable`) shows.
- **Step.** Press the “Weekly status” button in the “Show” group.
- **Check:** The History grid shows.
- **Check:** (`progress`) met when `(await p.locator('.hcell.tone-on, .hcell.tone-risk, .hcell.tone-off').count()) > 20`. Else it says: the history grid has too few check-ins.
- _Note:_ Each goal's number now, at the end of its row (backlog GP).
- **Check:** (`progress`) met when `(await p.locator('.hgrid td.h-value').first().innerText()).trim().length > 0`. Else it says: the history grid doesn’t say each goal’s number now.
- **Check:** Checkpoint “history”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- _Note:_ The choice is remembered, and the tabs still choose which goals and how they're grouped.
- Go to `/goals?show=teams` in the demo.
- **Check:** The qtable, or the History grid (`.qtable, .hgrid`) shows.
- **Check:** (`parity`) met when `(await openLayout(p)) === 'History'`. Else it says: the layout was not remembered.
- _Note:_ Export: a workbook, and JSON another tool can read.
- **Step.** Open the Views menu (the View sheet on a phone) at its Export these goals button.
- **Step.** Press the Export these goals button.
- **Check:** Checkpoint “export”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- _Note:_ The other formats are one click away (import spec 2.9).
- **Step.** Press the “Other formats” button.
- **Check:** (`finish`) met when `/-goals-all-\d{4}-\d\d-\d\d\.xlsx$/.test(xlsx.suggestedFilename()) && fs.statSync(await xlsx.path()).size > 4000`, where `const [xlsx] = await Promise.all([p.waitForEvent('download'), h.click(p.getByRole('button', { name: 'Export .xlsx' }))])`. Else it says: the workbook was not saved as …-goals-all-{date}.xlsx: {xlsx.suggestedFilename()}.
- **Check:** (`logged`) met when `data.format === 'goals-app.export' && data.goals.length === s.goals.length && data.goals.some((g) => g.checkIns.length) && brief.includes('## How to read the status') && brief.includes('**Recovery plan:**')`, where `const [json] = await Promise.all([p.waitForEvent('download'), h.click(p.getByRole('button', { name: 'Save .json' }))])`; `const data = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(await json.path(), 'utf8'))`; `const [md] = await Promise.all([p.waitForEvent('download'), h.click(p.getByRole('button', { name: 'Save .md' }))])`; `const brief = fs.readFileSync(await md.path(), 'utf8')`; `const s = await h.snapshot()`. Else it says: the JSON or brief is incomplete.
- _Note:_ A filtered All tab exports what's shown, and its file never says `all`, which means everything (IM7 review).
- Go to `/goals?scope=all&attention=1` in the demo.
- **Step.** Open the Views menu (the View sheet on a phone) at its Export these goals button.
- **Step.** Press the Export these goals button.
- **Check:** (`finish`) met when `/-goals-as-shown-\d{4}-\d\d-\d\d\.xlsx$/.test(part.suggestedFilename())`, where `const [part] = await Promise.all([p.waitForEvent('download'), h.click(p.getByRole('button', { name: 'Export .xlsx' }))])`. Else it says: a filtered All tab was not saved as …-goals-as-shown-{date}.xlsx: {part.suggestedFilename()}.
- _Note:_ Data's Export → Everything… opens the same sheet, for everything; closed, the focus goes back to Export (#248 review).
- Go to `/data` in the demo.
- **Step.** Press the summary in the data export (`.data-export > summary`).
- **Step.** Press the “Everything…” button.
- **Check:** The “Export .xlsx” button in the “Export” dialog shows.
- **Check:** (`finish`) met when `/-goals-all-\d{4}-\d\d-\d\d\.xlsx: \d+ goals, as of week \d+\./.test(note)`, where `const sheet = p.getByRole('dialog', { name: 'Export' })`; `const note = await sheet.locator('.export-note').innerText()`. Else it says: Everything… on Data does not name an …-all-{date}.xlsx of n goals as of this week: {note}.
- Press the Escape key.
- **Check:** The “Export” dialog goes away.
- **Check:** (`a11y`) met when `await p.evaluate(() => !!document.activeElement?.matches('.data-export > summary'))`. Else it says: closing Export opened from Data left the focus on the page, not on Export.
- Close this browser.
